title: MET - Music-Induced Emotion EEG Dataset
description: The MET dataset comprises 128-channel EEG recordings (downsampled to 66 channels post-preprocessing) collected from 20 participants during resting-state and music-listening conditions. Each participant underwent one resting-state session and twenty music-listening sessions, each corresponding to a distinct song lasting 130 seconds. The dataset is intended to support research on music-induced emotion and neural correlates of affective responses to music.
methods_description: EEG signals were originally recorded using a 128-channel EEG system at a sampling rate of 1000 Hz. Each music-listening session lasted 130 seconds, comprising 5 seconds before music onset, 120 seconds of music playback, and 5 seconds after offset. After preprocessing and channel selection, 66 EEG channels were retained and organized according to the BIDS specification.
